claims.statement: A rejected action restores the exact previous value and exposes the async error state.
Cancellation stops the underlying async action and exposes cancelled status without falsely committing the prediction.

component.purpose: Make optimistic UI state immediate while making commit, cancellation, and rollback explicit.
component.title: useOptimisticAction

states.description: The hook exposes an idle optimistic controller with commit and rollback actions.
